name: Desktop download guide and release-metadata fallback are usable

planSteps.description: Open https://muster.orazen.online/download.html in a fresh browser context. Inspect links without clicking downloads or executing the CLI command.
The page has links for Muster.dmg, Muster-intel.dmg, Muster-setup.exe, Muster.deb and Muster.AppImage under https://muster.today/downloads/.
Expand the SHA-256 checksums section and wait for /downloads/latest.json to finish or fail.

For a successful latest.json response containing checksums, the rendered checksum list matches that response. If that request fails, the list reads Checksums will be available after the next release. A Loading placeholder must not remain after a settled failure.
If latest.json contains a version, the version badge displays v followed by that exact version; otherwise the static version remains. Do not assert a source package version as an installed release.
The page explains that users do not need to deploy a server or manage a container, and includes an Open Muster link to /app and CLI instructions without executing them.
